name: English Riddles
title: English Riddles: Easy to Impossible 🧩 32 Riddles | Can You Solve Them All?
about: 32 English riddles and trick questions, from easy to impossible. Think fast!
ar: ألغاز باللغة الإنجليزية من السهل إلى المستحيل — هل تستطيع حلها كلها؟
fr: Devinettes en anglais du plus facile à l'impossible — sauras-tu toutes les résoudre ?
levels: What has hands but can't clap?
A clock has hands that show the time!
What has legs but can't walk?
What has one eye but can't see?
A needle has an eye for the thread!
What can you catch but not throw?
You catch a cold when you get sick!
What goes up but never comes down?
What has teeth but can't bite?
A comb has teeth for your hair!
What has words but never speaks?
A book is full of words!
What is full of holes but still holds water?
A sponge is full of holes!
Every month has at least 28 days!
What word is always spelled wrong?
The word 'wrong' is always spelled W-R-O-N-G!
What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
Minute has one M. Moment has two!
What gets bigger the more you take away?
The more you dig, the bigger the hole!
What can you break without touching it?
You break a promise with words!
What has a head and a tail but no body?
What starts with T, ends with T, and has T in it?
A river runs, but it can't walk!
How many letters are in "the alphabet"?
How many letters are in the words, the alphabet?
If you share me, you don't have me anymore. What am I?
Once you share a secret, it's not a secret!
What can travel around the world but stays in a corner?
A stamp stays in the corner of a letter!
Mary's father has 5 daughters: Nana, Nene, Nini, Nono and...?
It's Mary's father! The 5th daughter is Mary.
What 5-letter word becomes shorter when you add 2 letters?
It's black when you buy it, red when you use it, and gray when you throw it away. What is it?
A man walks in the rain with no umbrella and no hat, but not one hair gets wet. How?
Forward I'm heavy, backward I'm not. What am I?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. What am I?
An echo repeats what you say!
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
Every step leaves a footstep behind!
Which is heavier: a kilo of feathers or a kilo of stones?
I'm tall when I'm young and short when I'm old. What am I?
A candle gets shorter as it burns!
What has cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish?
A map shows cities, forests and water!
What begins with E, ends with E, and has only one letter?
What is so fragile that saying its name breaks it?
Say 'silence' and the silence is broken!
What can fill a room but takes up no space?
Light fills a room, but it takes no space!
